correctness.rationale: There are 2^15−1=32767 nonzero binary ternary quartics, acted upon by GL3(F2) of order 168. The supplied source enumerates 279 exact coefficient-vector orbits, tests geometric smoothness via unit ideals of (F,Fx,Fy,Fz) on all three affine charts using exact Gröbner bases (not finite-extension sampling), and obtains 78 smooth orbits, 10920 smooth forms. Seven Fano-plane point/gradient incidences determine tangent covering and blocking; independent direct all-smooth-form tally agrees with orbit-weighting. The 2x2 table (2040,616,1848,6416) sums 10920 and has tangent marginal 2656 and blocking marginal 3888. I inspected the entire verifier source and its GL3/F2 orbit action, smoothness ideals and direct coefficient loop; no exhaustive rerun of its lengthy SymPy calculation is claimed here, but the finite procedure is bounded and complete by construction, and two explicit nonimplication quartics are checked in the package.
